title: crypto2dev TLS: TLS 1.2 integration test
description: Write an integration test that performs a complete TLS 1.2 handshake and data exchange with crypto2dev active. Cover ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256 and ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384 cipher suites. RSA server certificate key should be in a KEY fd (imported via wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid()). Verify: handshake completes, RSA signature during Server Key Exchange is served by hardware, AES-GCM record encryption is served by hardware.
notes: TLS 1.2 RSA auth path: server calls wc_RsaSSL_Sign() → CryptoCb → DO_SIGN on KEY fd. This should work cleanly since the digest is pre-hashed before the CryptoCb is called. Confirm this works with the RSA-4096 key size limit of crypto2dev.
